steps.name: precheck-task81-local-100k-surface
args: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS ecaz; SELECT now() AS captured_at, version() AS postgres_version; SELECT count(*) AS corpus_rows FROM task79_surface_100k_corpus; SELECT count(*) AS query_rows FROM task79_surface_100k_queries; SELECT c.relname, c.relpages, c.reltuples::bigint AS reltuples, c.reloptions FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relname = 'task79_surface_100k_idx'; WITH q AS (SELECT source FROM task79_surface_100k_queries ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) SELECT leaf_block_available_count, leaf_block_selected_count, leaf_block_skipped_count, leaf_summary_object_bytes, leaf_row_object_bytes, leaf_summary_score_nanos, leaf_row_score_nanos FROM q, LATERAL ec_spire_index_scan_leaf_candidate_snapshot('task79_surface_100k_idx'::regclass, q.source) LIMIT 1; SELECT name, setting, context FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('ec_spire.leaf_block_rows', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_max_blocks_per_leaf', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_max_global_blocks', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_global_probe_blocks', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_sample_rows_per_block', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_sample_summary_prior_weight', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_summary_radius_weight', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_route_prior_weight', 'ec_spire.nprobe', 'ec_spire.rerank_width') ORDER BY name;

steps.name: diagnostics-100k-rabitq-block-summary-global1152
args: SET ec_spire.nprobe = 96; SET ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_max_blocks_per_leaf = 0; SET ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_max_global_blocks = 1152; SET ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_global_probe_blocks = 0; SET ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_sample_rows_per_block = 0; SET ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_sample_summary_prior_weight = 0.8; SET ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_summary_radius_weight = 0.25; SET ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_route_prior_weight = 0.0; WITH queries AS (SELECT id, source FROM task79_surface_100k_queries ORDER BY id LIMIT 200), per_leaf AS (SELECT q.id, s.* FROM queries q CROSS JOIN LATERAL ec_spire_index_scan_leaf_candidate_snapshot('task79_surface_100k_idx'::regclass, q.source) s) SELECT count(DISTINCT id) AS query_count, sum(candidate_row_count) AS candidate_rows, sum(leaf_block_available_count) AS blocks_available, sum(leaf_block_selected_count) AS blocks_selected, sum(leaf_block_skipped_count) AS blocks_skipped, sum(leaf_summary_object_bytes) AS summary_bytes, sum(leaf_row_object_bytes) AS row_bytes, sum(leaf_summary_score_nanos) AS summary_score_nanos, sum(leaf_row_score_nanos) AS row_score_nanos, sum(candidate_score_nanos) AS candidate_score_nanos FROM per_leaf;
